Cowboy hunting game where players ride horses and shoot targets with precision. Control your horse's movement, feel real-time saddle vibrations, and compete in split-screen duels on a 75-inch HD display with immersive sound effects. Adventure through the wild and master mounted marksmanship



>> Features of Interactive Horse Riding&Hunting:


  • Realistic Horseback Simulation: Fully controllable horse movement with tactile saddle feedback.

  • Split-Screen Multiplayer Mode: Compete head-to-head with friends in real-time.

  • Immersive Display & Audio: 75-inch HD screen with surround sound for a cinematic experience.

  • Precision Shooting Mechanics: Accurate target recognition and scoring system.

  • Adventure Game Mode: Explore themed wild west scenarios while mastering marksmanship skills.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Interactive Horse Riding&Hunting:


Entertainment Value: Ideal for amusement parks, arcade centers, family entertainment venues, and themed exhibitions.


Skill Development: Enhances coordination, timing, and focus through interactive gameplay.

Immersive Experience: Combines motion, sound, and visual elements for a realistic cowboy adventure.


Educational & Training Use: Can be adapted for horse riding or shooting instruction via simulation.


Custom Integration: Compatible with InnovativeRobo’s robotic systems for extended functionality and motion accuracy.



>> Product Number: LJST002


  • Floor area: 2.4m*3.4m*2.5m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-5 minutes

  • Power: 900w



>> FAQs for Interactive Horse Riding&Hunting:


Q1: How many players can play at once?

A1: The game supports up to two players simultaneously in split-screen mode.


Q2: Does the saddle vibrate or move during gameplay?

A2: Yes, the saddle provides real-time vibration feedback to simulate riding motion and enhance immersion.


Q3: What display setup is required?

A3: The game comes equipped with a built-in 75-inch HD display for optimal visibility and multiplayer interaction.


Q4: Is this suitable for children?

A4: Yes, the game can be adjusted for different age groups, with safety and difficulty levels customizable.


Q5: Can this be customized for branding or educational themes?

A5: Absolutely. The system supports customization for promotional events, training scenarios, and themed environments.
